brief:
The Palestinian Center for Policy Studies warned that the so-called "yellow line" in Gaza—presented as a preliminary Israeli withdrawal line and temporary security arrangement following the October 2025 ceasefire agreement—is transforming into a permanent partition, Shehab Wire reported.

The center's analysis suggests the temporary demarcation is hardening into a de facto border, altering Gaza's territorial reality beyond what ceasefire terms originally envisioned. The yellow line's conversion from provisional military arrangement to enduring separation raises questions about the strip's eventual political and administrative structure.

title: Israel's "yellow line" in Gaza shifts from temporary buffer to permanent partition
